WITH ranked AS MATERIALIZED (
             SELECT ap.id, bm25(passages_fts) AS lexical_score
             FROM passages_fts
             CROSS JOIN active_passages AS ap ON ap.id = passages_fts.rowid
             
    JOIN project_sources AS ps
      ON ps.source_id = ap.source_id
     AND ps.removed_at IS NULL
    JOIN document_heads AS dh
      ON dh.document_id = ap.document_id
     AND dh.document_version_id = ap.document_version_id
     AND dh.state = 'active'
    JOIN document_versions AS dv
      ON dv.id = ap.document_version_id
     AND dv.document_id = ap.document_id
             JOIN chunks AS c INDEXED BY chunks_order_idx ON c.id = ap.chunk_id
             WHERE ps.project_id = x'B4B9A58528C54C8897C2E5661C82A151'
               AND passages_fts MATCH '"immutable" AND "citation" AND "evidence"'
             ORDER BY lexical_score ASC,
                      ap.source_id ASC,
                      ap.document_id ASC,
                      c.start_byte ASC
             LIMIT 50 OFFSET 0
         )
         SELECT 
        (
            length(ap.source_id) != 16
            OR length(ap.document_id) != 16
            OR length(dv.revision_sha256) != 32
            OR length(CAST(dv.source_uri AS BLOB)) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 16384
            OR length(CAST(COALESCE(dv.title, '') AS BLOB)) > 16384
            OR length(CAST(c.body_text AS BLOB)) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1800
            OR length(c.content_sha256) != 32
            OR length(c.quote_bloom) != 512
            OR (
                dv.source_updated_at IS NOT NULL
                AND length(CAST(dv.source_updated_at AS BLOB)) > 128
            )
            OR length(CAST(dv.indexed_at AS BLOB)) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 128

        ap.id,
        CASE WHEN length(ap.source_id) = 16 THEN ap.source_id ELSE zeroblob(0) END,
        CASE WHEN length(ap.document_id) = 16 THEN ap.document_id ELSE zeroblob(0) END,

            ELSE zeroblob(0)
        END,
        CASE

                 BETWEEN 1 AND 16384
            THEN dv.source_uri ELSE ''
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN length(CAST(COALESCE(dv.title, '') AS BLOB)) <= 16384
            THEN COALESCE(dv.title, '') ELSE ''
        END,
        c.start_byte,
        c.end_byte,
        c.start_line,
        c.end_line,
        CASE
            WHEN length(CAST(c.body_text AS BLOB))
                 BETWEEN 1 AND 1800
            THEN c.body_text ELSE ''
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN length(c.content_sha256) = 32 THEN c.content_sha256
            ELSE zeroblob(0)
        END,
        CASE WHEN length(c.quote_bloom) = 512 THEN c.quote_bloom ELSE zeroblob(0) END,
        CASE
            WHEN dv.source_updated_at IS NULL
              OR length(CAST(dv.source_updated_at AS BLOB)) <= 128
            THEN dv.source_updated_at ELSE NULL
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN length(CAST(dv.indexed_at AS BLOB))
                 BETWEEN 1 AND 128
            THEN dv.indexed_at ELSE ''
        END,
        dh.generation_id, ranked.lexical_score
         FROM ranked
         CROSS JOIN active_passages AS ap ON ap.id = ranked.id
         
    JOIN project_sources AS ps
      ON ps.source_id = ap.source_id
     AND ps.removed_at IS NULL
    JOIN document_heads AS dh
      ON dh.document_id = ap.document_id
     AND dh.document_version_id = ap.document_version_id
     AND dh.state = 'active'
    JOIN document_versions AS dv
      ON dv.id = ap.document_version_id
     AND dv.document_id = ap.document_id
         JOIN chunks AS c ON c.id = ap.chunk_id
         WHERE ps.project_id = x'B4B9A58528C54C8897C2E5661C82A151'

cancellation_smoke.scope: Small real-model fixture; not million-passage qualification.

controls_source:
import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,sys,time
repo=pathlib.Path('/Users/b.k./Desktop/hSUM');sys.path.insert(0,str(repo))
from benches.retrieval_scale.harness import command_environment,readiness_probe_arguments
from benches.retrieval_stress.harness import run_cancel_storm,load_manifest
root=pathlib.Path('/Users/b.k./.cache/hsum-qualification/2026-10-21-WkRefX')
binaries={'before':root/'bin/hsum-before-source-partitions','after':repo/'target/release/hsum'}
output=repo/'eval/results/vector-source-2026-10-23-macos-diagnostic.json'
report=json.loads(output.read_text());assert 'cli_controls' not in report
report['binaries']={name:{'path':str(path),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for name,path in binaries.items()}
report['cli_controls']={'scope':'Small real-model controls, not latency qualification. Full ordered citations/scores/hashes compared, and every content checked against the live source byte window.','observations':[]}
reference={}
for repetition in range(3):
 for condition in (('before','after') if repetition%2==0 else ('after','before')):
  for mode in ['lexical','semantic','hybrid']:
   argv=readiness_probe_arguments(binaries[condition],'duplicate bounded evidence archive',mode)+['--explain']
   start=time.perf_counter()
   result=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=root/'cancel-smoke',env=command_environment(root/'home'),text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=40)
   elapsed=time.perf_counter()-start
   assert result.returncode==0,result.stderr
   packet=json.loads(result.stdout)
   identity=[(r['citation_uri'],r['score'],r['content_sha256']) for r in packet['results']]
   assert identity,packet
   if mode not in reference:reference[mode]=identity
   assert identity==reference[mode],(condition,mode)
   for row in packet['results']:
    assert row['source_uri']=='repo://evidence.md',row['source_uri']
    content=row['content'].encode();span=row['span']
    body=(root/'cancel-smoke/evidence.md').read_bytes()
    assert body[span['start_byte']:span['end_byte']]==content
    assert hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()==row['content_sha256']
   report['cli_controls']['observations'].append({'condition':condition,'repetition':repetition,'mode':mode,'argv':argv,'seconds':elapsed,'packet':packet,'stderr':result.stderr})
   output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
   print(condition,repetition,mode,len(identity),flush=True)
start=time.perf_counter()
report['cancellation_smoke']=run_cancel_storm(binaries['after'],root/'cancel-smoke',root/'home',load_manifest())
report['cancellation_smoke']['seconds']=time.perf_counter()-start
report['cancellation_smoke']['scope']='Small real-model fixture; not million-passage qualification.'
report['controls_source']=pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text()
output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report['cancellation_smoke']),flush=True)
